finding.title: Enlarge a 3x4 Matrix to 4x4 for a Small Partial Gain

reasons: target NozzleCtrl__FP7J3DNodei improved from 99.46512 to 99.60465 but did not reach exact as claimed; runner records improved progress

finding.why: NozzleCtrl changes Mtx to Mtx44 while both consumers remain 3x4 matrix operations. The added fourth row has no semantic consumer. The worker chooses this type because it supplies 16 extra bytes and recovers the frame size, while admitting that the actual matrix address is still wrong, target r1+0x28 versus candidate r1+0x14. Matching total frame size is not evidence that the original matrix had another row.
finding.score_attribution: 99.46512% to 99.60465%, only 0.13953 points, still partial. This is a particularly direct example of the user's concern: accepting a larger, unexplained source object because a few operands become closer.
finding.lint_candidate: Flag aggregate widening whose added elements are unused, especially when all consuming APIs still use the smaller shape. Pair with stack-delta evidence.

occurrences.detail: One matrix widened from 3x4 to 4x4 in NozzleCtrl.

note.summary: No source change retained. The target already matches in opcode/control-flow shape; the remaining differences are unexplained stack-frame/slot padding plus TU-level small-data symbol identity. Moving the genuine Mtx declaration from the guarded block to function scope produced exactly the same residual and was ablated. Adding fabricated unused storage would violate sms-stack-independent-matching and sms-temporary-tactics.

residual.class: stack slot or frame size, with relocation or symbol identity
rows: Target frame is 0x60; current frame is 0x50.
Target Mtx begins at r1+0x28; current Mtx begins at r1+0x14.
Target conversion spill slots are r1+0x58/r1+0x5c; current slots are r1+0x48/r1+0x4c.
Epilogue offsets differ consistently with the frame discrepancy.
The three floating constants reference different @sda21 symbol identities despite otherwise corresponding instruction shapes.
residual.mechanism: The meaningful instructions agree, but the retail function contains additional unexplained stack allocation that shifts the Mtx and conversion spill slots. No evidenced source local or inline boundary accounting for that allocation was found. Separately, TU-wide .sdata2 ownership/order causes the constant relocation identities to differ.

variants: Declare Mtx inside the negative-angle guarded block
tried_shapes.effect: No change: both compile to 99.46512% with the identical 0x60-versus-0x50 frame and 0x28-versus-0x14 Mtx-slot residual.

untried_leads: Recover an evidenced original inline/assert-stub boundary that naturally owns the missing stack space.
Resolve the WaterGun translation unit's .sdata2 constant ordering only after the stack discrepancy is independently explained.
Do not enable the commented unused arrays or add padding locals; project standards explicitly prohibit that tactic.
